fields.name: physician_inspector_oversight_required
fields.description: Whether the state requires appointed physician inspectors to supervise, control, and instruct midwives.
fields.sample_quote: The Secretary of Health of the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania shall appoint not more than five physicians, who shall serve as inspectors of midwives and who shall maintain close supervision over, and control and instruct such midwives

fields.name: student_obstetrics_supervision_exemption
fields.description: Whether medical or osteopathic students are explicitly exempted from midwifery licensure requirements when practicing obstetrics under faculty supervision.
fields.sample_quote: nothing in this section shall be construed to prohibit a student of medicine or osteopathy, matriculated at, and in attendance at, a legally incorporated medical school or osteopathic college...from practicing obstetrics, under the supervision of the faculty

fields.name: certificate_registration_required
fields.description: Whether the midwifery certificate must be registered with the issuing board in addition to being obtained.
fields.sample_quote: having said certificate registered in the office of the State Board of Medical Education and Licensure at Harrisburg, Pennsylvania

fields.name: substance_addiction_disqualifying
fields.description: Whether addiction to alcohol or narcotic drugs is an explicit statutory ground for refusing or revoking a license.
fields.sample_quote: The said board may refuse to grant a certificate to any person, and may revoke the license of any person, addicted to the use of alcohol or narcotic drugs

fields.name: physician_osteopath_practice_exemption
fields.description: Whether licensed physicians and osteopaths are explicitly exempted from midwifery licensure requirements.
fields.sample_quote: it shall be unlawful for any person or persons, except a duly licensed physician or osteopath, to practice midwifery in this Commonwealth, before receiving a certificate

fields.name: gratuitous_practice_included_in_definition
fields.description: Whether attending women in childbirth without compensation (gratuitously) is included in the statutory definition of practicing midwifery.
fields.sample_quote: who shall make a practice of attending women in childbirth gratuitously or for hire, shall be regarded as a midwife within the meaning of this act
